evals.prompt: Audit our page for on-page SEO
evals.expected_output: Checks title tag length and keyword placement, meta description, heading hierarchy (single h1, logical h2/h3), image alt text, internal links, and URL structure, with prioritized fixes.

evals.prompt: We have duplicate content across multiple URLs. Fix it
evals.expected_output: Recommends canonical tags pointing to the preferred URL, removes or redirects duplicates where possible, and updates the sitemap so only canonical URLs are listed.
